name: LaTeX Math Rendering
tagline: Render math in the apps your agent builds, from LaTeX: formulas, integrals and matrices that display correctly.
who: Anyone whose material has math in it: students and instructors working from a textbook or problem set, tutors, analysts and scientists with formulas in their data. If an app your agent built shows equations as raw backslash text or mangled symbols, this corrects it.
how:
Teaches your agent to render math with KaTeX in any app it builds:

- It adds the KaTeX library to the app.
- It drops in a <Math> component for single formulas and a <MathText> component for prose with inline math.
- It makes the agent capture math as LaTeX in the first place, transcribing it from the PDF or image instead of pasting the mangled characters that plain text extraction produces. This step decides whether the other two are any use.

A formula the agent cannot parse renders in place instead of breaking the app, so a rough transcription is always safe to show.
